newsitem.title: USA: CME pork bellies tumble near limit on sell stops.
newsitem.headline: CME pork bellies tumble near limit on sell stops.

text.p: CME pork bellies fell for a near limit loss of 2.950 cents per lb in August before finding support as concern over the cash market pushed prices down into sell stops, traders said.
August bellies fell 2.950 cents to 81.850 before recovering slightly. Futures are currently 2.425 to 2.675 cents lower with July off the least at 82.250 cents.
Recent gains in cash bellies elevated prices to $90 per cwt where demand appears to have waned. The high prices have cut interest for product, sources said.
